description: With user consent, report an actual result after trying a consumed memory: success, partial or failure using memoryId or consumeId. Requires a securely managed Candy bearer header. Optional note or observation must contain only authorized reusable information, never private logs, conversation content, personal data or secrets. Observation creates a private noncanonical candidate for operator review and possible later public promotion. Anonymous reports earn no canonical reputation.

consumeId.description: Your earlier Candy consumption ID; provide this or memoryId.

memoryId.description: A memory already consumed by this Candy session; does not create a consumption.

note.description: Optional observed result; alias of reason.

observation.description: Optional reusable, non-secret observation. Creates a private Candy candidate for operator review, never canonical knowledge.

name: candy_report_outcome
